== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Destruction aura is a powerful and corrosive force that functions as an aspect of [[vital aura]]. It possesses the capacity to erode, dissolve, and fundamentally disassemble both physical matter and spiritual constructs. When integrated with other elements, such as [[fire aura]], it can create devastating effects like black-and-red flames that consume fuel and materials instantly rather than through traditional burning. This aura can act as a cleansing force, stripping away corruption or unwanted elements, but it also carries an immense capacity for devastation, capable of leveling cities or depopulating worlds. It is often associated with intense fury and can be manifested through [[madra]], [[soulfire]], or specific techniques to destroy targets on a fundamental level by severing their very origin of existence.}}
